findings.reason: the honest change is to route the live-view read through the existing classifier (or share that one fold), not to write a stream fold in `mcp.py`, and §30 also says the same fold "should be what `complete` calls before promoting", which is the strong signal that it belongs on the existing owner, not in a third caller.
findings.text: §30 says the live view "takes phase from the stored pointer" and should fold the stream on read, but `_observed_phase`/the classifier already derive the phase a run's evidence supports (worker record, retained commits, stream-should-work, terminal manifest) precisely so a stored launcher label cannot stand; adding a second stream-fold in the MCP read path creates two phase derivations that will drift

findings.reason: one grep for `_observed_phase`/the classifier would have redirected §30 to an extension of the existing derivation instead of a new one, which is exactly the reuse map this item exists to make unfailable.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new behaviour is anchored on existing deep owners rather than spread into parallel small wrappers; §30 is the one place a second implementation is proposed, and it is reported under duplicate_owner.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §30 proposes folding the run phase from the stream in the MCP live view ("fold the phase from it on read"), which re-derives a phase that `reckon/crew/recovery.py` already derives from the run's own evidence (`_observed_phase` and the classifier), rather than routing the read through that existing derivation.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the existing mechanism for nearly every proposal (`_schema.py:plan_section_anchors`, `prompts.py` time fence, `lane_document.py:read_lane_throughput`, `runs.py` drain, `reports.py`/`promotion.py` for §38/§45), with the single exception noted under §30.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the repair-shaped sections (§31–§35, §43, §44) extend or correct a single owner and state why the owner cannot serve as-is; §44's reload gate and §43's unpadded cell are corrections to the existing ticker formatter, not new layers.
